source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40; Schedule of Credits line 2 (PDF p.28; Table 2 PDF p.44; bundle PDF p.7); Department FAQ 2; Schedule of Credits line 4 (PDF p.28; bundle PDF p.7); Department FAQ 2; Schedule of Credits line 9 (PDF p.29)

worked: Federal AGI = private pension person 0 28,454.00 = 28,454.00. Federal taxable income = 28,454.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 10,704.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 28,454.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Deductions: none; line 47 total 0.00; line 2b 0.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 28,454.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 28,454.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 28,454.00, in the band 40,000 or less: 2,400.00 each; 1 exemption x 2,400.00 = 2,400.00. Line 5 = 28,454.00 - 2,400.00 = 26,054.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 26,054.00. Line 8a tax: 26,054.00 is in the 26,050 to 100,000 band: 342.00 plus 2.750% of (26,054.00 - 26,050.00 = 4.00) = 342.00 + 0.11 = 342.11. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 342.11. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 28,454.00 - 2,400.00 = 26,054.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), under 100,000.00. Line 2 retirement income credit: covered retirement income 28,454.00; 200.00 (Table 2 at 8,001 or more: 200). Line 4 senior citizen credit: taxpayer is 65 or older at the end of the year; 50.00 per return. Line 10 credits = 200.00 + 50.00 = 250.00. Line 11 = 342.11 - 250.00 = 92.11. State income tax 92.11. The form works in whole dollars ('Round all figures to the nearest dollar', PDF p.5): line 8a would be 342; expected keeps the formula result. The printed 342.00 comes in at the first dollar over 26,050, and both credits apply against it. The form also gives the exemption credit (line 9: 1 x 20.00), leaving 72.11; not modelled, so expected stays 92.11.
accepted_approximations: Exemption credit: 20 for each exemption claimed when MAGI less exemptions is under 30,000. A low-income credit: it lowers tax only when taxable income is over 26,050 and MAGI less exemptions is under 30,000.
